title: Radioactive decay and half-life
basic_overview: Radioactive decay follows first-order kinetics: N=N₀e^(−λt), t½=ln2/λ, A=λN.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Write decay law. 2. Use λ=0.693/t½. 3. Count half-lives where possible. 4. Compute activity from A=λN.
extra_info_content.factors: Nuclear decay is fundamentally different from ordinary chemical kinetics.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
